ending.1:
Back in the Dike Town, the shard met the edge of the stone heart
with a small, clean click.
ending.2:
The next morning, Borg closed the drainage sluice with his own hands.
None of the ditch-diggers complained.
ending.3:
The lake filled over one summer.
Roofs, spires, and the queen on her throne went quietly back under the water.
ending.4:
Osa pushed her ferry out onto the lake
and sang the lullaby all the way through.
ending.5:
Even joined, the stone was still not whole.
Its broken edge points below the bottom of the capital,
toward a labyrinth from which, they say, no adventurer returns.
ending.end: - End of Part 2: The Sunken Capital -
town.title: The Dike Town
